verdict.rationale: Orrick publishes named AI-practice tools beyond marketing mentions — e.g. the Generative-AI-Policy-Builder-Tool for drafting AI acceptable-use policies, and Orrick Labs building 'tailored and practical legal technology solutions' — plus a broader Tech Studio suite of self-service tools. However, most named tools (Series A Ready, Privacy-in-a-Box, Startup Health Check, forms) are general startup/legal tools, not specifically about AI usage in client service, and there's no detailed policy or technical documentation of internal AI governance/methodology. missing for 10: detailed documentation of internal AI use policies/governance, independent corroboration of the AI-specific tools' effectiveness, and more named AI-specific (vs. general legal-tech) products.
